project.name: AR ELECTRO Projects
project.brand_promise: Turn ambitious engineering ideas into buildable, understandable projects.

design_directions.name: Red Signal Workshop
design_directions.description: Swiss poster composition fused with electronics bench photography and industrial label-making. Near-black structural canvas, large left-aligned typography, red functional highlights, hard rules and image crops.

design_directions.name: Project Field Manual
design_directions.description: Military field-guide indexing fused with engineering schematics and editorial magazine spreads. Category pages use numbered labels, grid coordinates and process notes.

design_directions.name: Blackboard Circuit Club
design_directions.description: Technical classroom blackboard texture fused with neo-brutalist cards and red marker annotations. More approachable for younger students while retaining credibility.

design_directions.name: Night Lab Archive
design_directions.description: Cinematic darkroom photography fused with museum archive cataloguing and mono metadata. Project photos feel like specimens, with restrained motion and generous black space.

design_directions.name: Redline Engineering Atlas
design_directions.description: Transit-map logic fused with exploded-view diagrams and a compact service directory. Red routes connect project categories and contact actions.
design_directions.best_for: Experimental alternate direction; avoid overcomplicating the MVP.

research_references.descriptor: Bold hero typography, macro hover previews, scroll-triggered transitions, and case-study storytelling led by strongest work.
Focused homepage hierarchy, gallery or magazine-style project grids, visible About and contact access, and 3–6 featured projects.
Explain challenge, contribution, decisions and outcomes; use concise positioning copy rather than long undifferentiated text.

typography.implementation: Use Google Fonts import or local fallback in index.css. Headings use Barlow Condensed 700/900, uppercase selectively, tracking-tight and leading-none. Body uses IBM Plex Sans 400/500 with leading-relaxed. Labels use IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, text-xs and tracking-[0.2em]. Never use Inter, Roboto or generic system fonts for headings.

colors.usage: Keep 80–90% monochrome; use #E51A4D only for CTA, active category, rules, metadata markers and key emphasis. No gradients. Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Verify normal text at 4.5:1 and large text at 3:1.
colors.forbidden: Do not use #7351B7, teal dashboard colors, full-screen gradients, or red text on dark red surfaces.

layouts.global: Responsive shell with visible desktop nav: AR ELECTRO mark, Projects, Categories, About, Contact, and red WhatsApp CTA. Solid dark header with bottom border; sticky only if content receives pt spacing.
layouts.home: Asymmetric 12-column Tetris grid. Hero spans md:col-span-8 with red index rail and project image; adjacent tall feature spans md:col-span-4. Below, category grid mixes 8/4, 4/4/4 and an intentionally empty offset cell.
layouts.categories: Filterable project index with direct grid children, 1 column mobile and 4 columns desktop. Each category card has photo crop, category number, short description and visible arrow; cards are flat with 1px borders.
layouts.detail: Editorial case-study: breadcrumb, project title, category metadata, dominant image, requirement/process/outcome sections, related projects and contact CTA.
layouts.about: Left-aligned company story with mission, credibility facts including GSTIN, founder/company image treatment if available later, YouTube tutorial strip, and a red contact prompt.
layouts.contact: Split layout: requirement copy and WhatsApp details on left, form on right using shadcn Input/Textarea/Form. Fields: name, email, phone, project requirement. Show confirmation with Sonner.
layouts.footer: Darkest solid surface, py-20 or py-32, giant AR ELECTRO wordmark at text-[10vw], links, GSTIN, YouTube and external project list.

grids.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12; mix hero, square, tall and filler spans; leave breathing room.
grids.cards: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 lg:gap-6; direct children only; align-items:start.
grids.borders: Use border-r and border-b selectively to expose a technical skeleton. Do not wrap grid items in unnecessary animation containers.

components.use: Use raw HTML and Tailwind for marketing layout. Use existing shadcn Button, Input, Textarea, Form, Label, Select, DropdownMenu, and Sonner for interactive behavior.
components.interaction_rules: Every button, link, input, menu, project card and key status gets a stable data-testid in kebab-case, e.g. project-category-card-drone, explore-projects-button, contact-form-submit-button. Never use native select for advanced choice; use shadcn Select.

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle CSS grain/noise overlay at low opacity with pointer-events-none and aria-hidden=true. Keep it decorative, not a gradient.
visual_enhancers.rules: Use 1px red rules as editorial dividers and small coordinate labels such as 01 / 09. Use object-cover image crops with clear subject visibility.
visual_enhancers.depth: Layer flat surfaces with border contrast and restrained ambient shadows; avoid glossy cards and excessive glass.
visual_enhancers.scrollbar: Customize scrollbar thumb using tinted charcoal and red hover; no gutter.

motion.library: CSS transitions for MVP; optionally Framer Motion and Lenis for marketing polish if already installed.
motion.entrance: Stagger project cards with opacity and translate-y; keep under 500ms.
motion.hover: Project images scale 1.03, arrow translates 4px, border shifts to #E51A4D, and text remains high contrast. Use transition-transform, transition-colors, transition-opacity only; never transition-all.
motion.press_focus: Buttons scale to 0.98 on active and use a visible 2px focus ring in #FF416D.
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap nonessential animation in prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and disable parallax/stagger for reduced-motion users.

media.strategy: Use curated technology/project images now; keep category cards data-driven so later client photos can replace URLs without layout changes. All images require descriptive alt text and loading=lazy except the hero.

drone_project.description: White quadcopter on a dark surface; use for Drone Project hero/card.
Hands operating a drone controller; use for drone process detail.
Drone above water and skyline; use for outcome or field-test imagery.

image_urls.other_categories: Use the image selector tool for electronics lab, circuit boards, mechanical prototyping, biomedical devices and IoT hardware before implementation. Do not use placeholder URLs or invented image URLs.

external_links.whatsapp: Use a wa.me link with the business number supplied by the client; do not invent a number.

requirements: Alt text for every meaningful image
aria-hidden=true for grain and decorative icons
Labels associated with every form input
Do not rely on color alone for category state
accessibility.contrast: Use warm off-white foreground on #111214 and explicit white text on #E51A4D buttons; check hover/focus states separately.

3d_libraries.decision: Not needed for MVP; project categories benefit more from crisp 2D imagery and fast browsing than immersion.
3d_libraries.optional: If later adding an interactive drone showcase, use React Three Fiber with Suspense, transparent canvas, adequate lighting and lazy loading.

content.intro: We're dedicated to transforming ideas into reality through innovative technology projects. Our mission is to spread knowledge and inspire the next generation of thinkers and creators.

implementation_notes.js_only: All handoff examples and component names use .js/.jsx, not .tsx.
global_rules: Do not use transparent header or content surfaces
Do not use emoji as icons
Do not make every section centered
Use generous spacing p-6 through p-20
Keep external links visibly labeled and open safely
implementation_notes.form_behavior: Validate required fields client-side, submit to backend API when available, show loading state, success/error toast, and preserve entered values on error. If backend integration is not yet available, isolate a clearly marked MOCKED submit handler and do not imply delivery.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create distinctive, non-template UI with asymmetry and editorial storytelling.
Use black and #E51A4D as the emotional anchor, with tinted neutrals and no gradients.
Every interactive and key informational element must include data-testid.
Use responsive mobile-first layouts and test desktop navigation visibility.
Use specific transitions, not transition-all; support reduced motion.
Use real curated images only; never placeholder image URLs.
Always ensure content remains readable over imagery with solid or scrim surfaces.
